label: Inkjet all-in-one, wired + wireless
description: Colour inkjet all-in-one (print/scan/copy/fax) with 10/100 Ethernet and dual-band 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi. Both interfaces are active at once, so the printer holds two IPs on two subnets unless one is disabled.
notes: Both wired (10/100) and wireless (2.4/5 GHz 802.11b/g/n) - the classic dual-homed endpoint that breaks naive one-IP-per-device models. No PoE; 100-240 VAC external adapter.
